name: infyvision-site
description: Infinity Vision website on Cloudflare Workers (static assets + enquiry API on D1).

scripts.validate: python3 tools/validate.py && node --check src/site.js && node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/assets/site.js && node tools/test-interactions.mjs && node tools/test-worker.mjs && html-validate 'public/**/*.html'
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply infyvision-enquiries --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run validate && wrangler d1 migrations apply infyvision-enquiries --remote && wrangler deploy
